bindingRow: The opening mark's `isolated` arm of the mark record (SpanMarks, src/mark-record.ts), assigned by markFact (src/parse/inline/mark-facts.ts) and read by markStandsApart (src/print/span-marks.ts). The mark stands apart from its content exactly where the SOURCE put whitespace between them, which is the fact the printed atom's glueLeft was standing in for. WIDER, and the shape that widens it: a kept whitespace run, a hard break's own leading space or a monospace span's edge padding all leave the first content atom's glueLeft TRUE, so the old read fused the mark; the source put whitespace there, so the `isolated` arm stands it apart. Measured: no document of the corpus, either registry grid or the deep sweeps changes output, so the widening is unreached there.
mutant: markFact (src/parse/inline/mark-facts.ts) returns `entangled` for every mark, so no mark is ever isolated. Measured: 9 test files and 62 tests red, tests/format/inline-span-break.test.ts among them.

witness: a lone `--` at a SPAN CONTENT edge, e.g. `b**\t--\t**b**` or `__\t-- x__`, still folds its whitespace and gains an em dash where the input renders literal dashes.
bindingRow: Both marks' `entangled` arm of the mark record (SpanMarks, src/mark-record.ts), read where appendSpan (src/print/inline.ts) computes `flush` for constrainedIsLegal. The byte test and the join test this function needed are one read of the source: a run kept beside a lone `--` rides inside the first content atom, so the join in front of it is glue and only the bytes saw it, which is what the issue came out as. DIRECTION: the measured width is EQUAL, not wider. The deleted function answered true when neither the JOIN nor the edge BYTE carried whitespace at either edge, and that disjunction is exactly "the source put whitespace at an edge", which is the arm; whitespace-only content answers false under both. This row records `wider` because the schema's direction set (DIRECTIONS, scripts/lib/deletion-ledger.ts) spells only wider and narrower, and wider is its nearest value; a `same` value is worth adding and is not this change's to add.
mutant: markFact (src/parse/inline/mark-facts.ts) returns `isolated` for every mark, so no span is ever flush and no doubled span shortens. Measured: 30 test files and 197 tests red, tests/format/inline-formatting.test.ts among them; the shape itself is pinned by tests/parser/inline-marks.test.ts, "a run kept beside a lone dash pair isolates the mark".
